newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: Burkina Faso student strike spreads to schools.
newsitem.headline: Burkina Faso student strike spreads to schools.

text.p: Police in Burkina Faso fired teargas on Tuesday to break up a fresh student protest after a university strike spread, witnesses said.
Police deployed around the main secondary schools in the West African nation's capital Ougadougo, where schools have been deserted since Monday.

The National Association of Burkinabe Students (ANEB) called a strike from last Wednesday to back demands ranging from allowances for certain students to cheaper bus fares and improved food in the university restaurant.
Burkina Faso's human rights watchdog MBDHP said dozens of university and secondary school students, including four student leaders, had been arrested and it urged dialogue to end the dispute.
